rationale: The assistant correctly said TVs are outside its scope, pointed to the manufacturer support line or a specialist electronics repairer, and warned not to open the case because of the power supply's dangerous charge. It was brief and offered no simple non-invasive checks such as changing the input, a power reset or a torch test. It also did not ask whether there was sound, so the pointer was less tailored than it could have been, though it made no fabrications and no unsafe suggestions.
